response.text:
I can do that, but I need a few things before I forward anything (forwarding private email is externally visible and requires explicit confirmation):

Please confirm the following:
1. Which advisor — give the advisor’s email address (or confirm the exact name and that I should use the address on file). I will not guess.  
2. Which thread — provide the thread subject or paste a short unique snippet from the messages so I forward the correct conversation.  
3. Include attachments? (yes/no)  
4. Add a cover note? If yes, paste the text you want me to include or say you want me to draft one.  
5. Final confirmation to proceed (please reply with a clear “Yes — forward [subject] to [email address]” so I have explicit permission).

If you prefer, I can draft the forwarded message first and show it to you before sending. Which would you like?
